mapper.sql: *, code AS employeesCode, (SELECT name FROM positions WHERE id = position_id) AS positionName, (SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payroll_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND payroll_item_id = 5 AND payroll_id IN (SELECT id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND payrolls.pay_date <= #{filter.filterMonth} AND NOT payrolls.pay_date = '2020-11-25' )) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM deposit_request_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND deposit_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM deposit_requests WHERE is_active = 1 AND date <= #{filter.filterMonth}) )) AS depositAmount
mapper.select: SELECT pd.id, DATE_FORMAT(p.pay_date, "%d-%b-%Y") AS date, CONCAT_WS('','+', pd.amount,'$') AS historyAmount FROM payrolls AS p INNER JOIN payroll_details AS pd ON p.id = pd.payroll_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND pd.is_active = 1 AND pd.payroll_item_id = 5 AND pd.amount > 0 AND p.pay_date <= #{filterMonth} AND p.employee_id = #{employeesId} AND NOT p.pay_date = '2020-11-25' UNION SELECT eab.id, DATE_FORMAT(eab.date, "%d-%b-%Y") AS date, CONCAT_WS('','+', eab.amount,'$') AS historyAmount FROM employee_adjust_beginnings AS eab WHERE eab.is_active = 1 AND eab.date <= #{filterMonth} AND eab.employee_id = #{employeesId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT drd.id, DATE_FORMAT(dr.request_date, "%d-%b-%Y") AS date, CONCAT_WS('','-', drd.amount,'$') AS historyAmount FROM deposit_requests AS dr INNER JOIN deposit_request_details AS drd ON dr.id = drd.deposit_request_id WHERE drd.is_active = 1 AND drd.status = 2 AND drd.employee_id = #{employeesId} AND dr.date <= #{filterMonth} ORDER BY DATE(dr.request_date) DESC

SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT(request_date, "%d-%b-%Y") AS requestDate, date AS filterMonth, title AS title, (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM deposit_request_details WHERE deposit_request_id = deposit_requests.id AND is_active = 1) AS amountRequest, (SELECT username FROM users WHERE id = created_by) AS createdByName FROM deposit_requests WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{id}

SELECT status AS status, remark AS remark, (SELECT date FROM deposit_requests WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{depositRequestId})AS filterMonth, amount AS amountRequest, employee_id AS id, (SELECT code FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = employee_id) AS employeesCode, (SELECT name_kh FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = employee_id) AS nameKh, (SELECT name_en FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = employee_id) AS nameEn, (SELECT name FROM positions WHERE is_active = 1 AND id IN (SELECT position_id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = employee_id)) AS positionName, (SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payroll_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND payroll_item_id = 5 AND payroll_id IN (SELECT id FROM payrolls WHERE payrolls.is_active = 1 AND employee_id = dr.employee_id AND payrolls.pay_date <= #{filterMonth} AND NOT payrolls.pay_date = '2020-11-25' )) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM deposit_request_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = dr.employee_id AND deposit_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM deposit_requests WHERE is_active = 1 AND date < #{filterMonth}))) AS depositAmount FROM deposit_request_details AS dr WHERE dr.is_active = 1 AND dr.deposit_request_id = #{depositRequestId}
mapper.sql: *, DATE_FORMAT(request_date, "%d-%b-%Y") AS requestDate, DATE_FORMAT(created, "%d-%m-%Y %k:%i") AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(modified, "%d-%m-%Y %k:%i") AS modifiedDate, title AS title, (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM deposit_request_details WHERE deposit_request_id = deposit_requests.id AND is_active = 1) AS amountRequest, (SELECT username FROM users WHERE id = deposit_requests.created_by) AS createdByName, (SELECT username FROM users WHERE id = deposit_requests.modified_by) AS modifiedByName
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM deposit_request_details WHERE deposit_request_id = #{depositRequestId} AND status = 1 AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deposit_requests ( request_date, date, title, status, created, created_by, modified, modified_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{deposit.requestDate}, #{deposit.filterMonth}, #{deposit.title}, #{deposit.status}, NOW(), #{deposit.createdBy}, NOW()NULL, #{deposit.modifiedBy}, #{deposit.isActive} );

INSERT INTO deposit_request_details ( deposit_request_id, employee_id, amount, remark, status, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{depositDetail.depositRequestId}, #{depositDetail.employeesId}, #{depositDetail.amountRequest}, #{depositDetail.remark}, #{depositDetail.status}, NOW(), #{depositDetail.createdBy}, #{depositDetail.isActive} );
mapper.update: UPDATE deposit_requests SET title = #{deposit.title}, request_date = #{deposit.requestDate}, date = #{deposit.filterMonth}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{deposit.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{deposit.id}
